description: Emerging DMV discovery platform THFCTRY presents 'FCTRY RESET' a 1-hour monthly iOS update of sounds emanating from the Nation’s Capital - Washington DC, hosted by co-creators Matt Jackson and Avery "The Shogun Supreme" featuring all of the raw materials and necessary cultural clockwork present in the growing DMV music scene, exclusively dedicated to highlighting the best & brightest artists hailing from the inner sections of DC and Maryland, all the way through the heart of Virginia for an all-in-one, one of a kind radio experience.
title: FCTRY RESET
